sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for a clean comic medieval fantasy mobile tower-defense game. Match the supplied approved style reference: dark espresso confident outlines, chunky purposeful silhouettes, 2 or 3 hard-edged painted values, restrained broad highlights. Readable, manually designed feeling. No photorealism, airbrush, plastic gloss, gratuitous tiny engravings or microscopic texture, soft glow, external cast shadow, text, letters, numbers, watermark or UI screenshot. Reference is STYLE AND COLOR DEPTH only. Make a DIFFERENT cozy guild expedition MAP ROOM with a low broad wooden planning table, no shop. PORTRAIT 3:4 framing, slightly elevated frontal view. Dark oak roof beams in top corners, warm timber-and-pale-stone walls, navy blue hanging banners at far left and right, an arched bright sky-blue window in upper right with distant green trees and castle roof, broad intentional golden daylight and cooler blue shadow. Central 70% of the image is a broad quiet wooden table surface seen at an overhead angle, reserved for a SEPARATELY OVERLAID mini battlefield island; no objects in that central space. Only a small rolled parchment and compass tucked at extreme far left edge, one small satchel tucked at far right edge. Background architecture occupies upper third. Table surface and short front edge below occupy middle and lower thirds. Clear foreground/midground/background depth and warm-cool balance. Don't paint a map, castle model, diorama, circle or island on the table. No characters, title board, interface, embedded buttons, candles, glow or vignette. Keep middle subdued enough for clean cream UI type.

One SINGLE isolated miniature battlefield DIORAMA on a floating oval chunk of ochre earth and chunky sandstone, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera about 35 degrees looking downward, the SAME view used for medieval mobile game level islands. Whole island and ALL props comfortably inside square image with 12% transparent margin. The island top is a warm winding dirt road crossing between a few grouped props, the foreground cross section is shallow chunky warm rock, with a few broad angular grass clumps. No pedestal, no frame, no object outside the island, no haze, no particles. Favor strong large masses and clean color separation. Road is broad, unoccupied and easy to read. OUTPOST theme: a modest wooden palisade gate with small blue cloth at back-left, a stout small timber lookout tower at back-right with red pennant, central ochre road extends from back gate diagonally toward a short two-plank bridge at front-center. Only three round chunky green canopy trees grouped along edges, one blue shield beside the tower. Warm orange oak and light sandstone, bright fresh green trees, saturated blue/red accents. Road occupies most of top surface. Compact crafted scenic storytelling, not a realistic aerial landscape. No enemies, soldiers or hero.
